detail.longDescription: 🚀 Meta Open Sources the Code to Build Your Own Muse Gadgets Meta has open sourced the code to build Muse gadgets. Use a Raspberry Pi or ESP32 board, connect your own displays and sensors, and pair it with the Muse app. Meta is also giving away 5,000 Muse Home Link devices.
